subject: Onsite demo — travel conflict and coverage plan
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@veridianhealth.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, May 20, 2027 at 9:15 AM PDT
Subject: Redwood onsite demo — Friday 5/21 at 2:00pm PT

Hi Liam / Natalie,

Great to get this on the calendar — we’re excited to show the inference flow and how prefix caching can reduce your per-token cost during clinician workflows. Quick confirmation: we have you down for Friday, May 21 at 2:00pm PT onsite at your HQ (2nd floor, Lab B). Rafael will run the technical portion and I’ll handle the product walkthrough. Logan will be onsite as backup for logistics.

Attached: redwood-demo-runbook.pdf (run order + demo scripts). I’ve also added a Google Calendar invite here: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abcd1234

If anything changes on your side (travel, last-minute guest), let us know — we can record and/or run a condensed session.

Thanks,
Olga Petrov
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0198

From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@veridianhealth.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Cc: Natalie Chen <natalie.chen@veridianhealth.com>
Date: Fri, May 21, 2027 at 8:02 AM PDT
Subject: Re: Redwood onsite demo — Friday 5/21 at 2:00pm PT

Hi Olga —

Thanks for the details. Quick update: an urgent vendor audit pulled our Head of IT into a site visit for Friday morning and it looks like Liam (me) will be traveling back that afternoon. I’m in transit during the 2:00pm slot and won’t be able to take the full demo. Natalie can attend, but she’s not the end decision-maker.

Do you have availability Monday 5/24 afternoon? If not, short-term options: 1) proceed at 2pm and record the technical portion for me, or 2) run a condensed 30-min exec overview that Natalie can lead with internally.

Apologies for the curveball — totally our fault for late travel.

—Liam
Liam O'Connor
Director, Clinical Ops | Veridian Health
liam.oconnor@veridianhealth.com

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, May 21, 2027 at 8:45 AM PDT
Subject: Fwd: Redwood onsite demo — Friday 5/21 at 2:00pm PT — prospect traveling, need coverage/plan

Team — forwarding Liam's note. He’ll be in transit for our 2pm slot. Options: record the full technical run and still meet with Natalie for executive overview, or postpone to Mon 5/24 afternoon. Rafael — can you confirm if you and Logan can still be onsite at 2pm to run the demo and record the technical session? Marissa — can you own the recording and upload (Drive + share link) and then handle the follow-up MPO (mutual plan of action)? We should also prepare a 30-min executive condensate to present live in case they prefer that.

Priority checklist: 
- Confirm onsite coverage (Rafael)
- Recording + upload (Marissa)
- Draft condensed 30-min slide outline and key decision asks (Olga)
- Tentative reschedule options if Liam insists on being present (Mon 5/24 1-4pm PT)

Attachments: veridian-site-itinerary.xlsx (their visitor schedule for Friday)

Thanks — appreciate quick responses so we can lock in with Liam.

Olga

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, May 21, 2027 at 9:05 AM PDT
Subject: Re: Fwd: Redwood onsite demo — Friday 5/21 at 2:00pm PT — prospect traveling, need coverage/plan

Olga / team —

I can still be onsite at 2pm and run the technical demo. Logan can cover logistics and the AV. Happy to record the whole run (we have a short checklist in the runbook) and tag timestamps for the parts that are most decision-impacting (latency/cost section at ~00:22 and rollout/compatibility at ~00:38). Marissa — if you can make the upload and send the link to Liam and Natalie immediately after, that should cover the shortfall.

If Liam requests Monday, I’m available 5/24 2-4pm PT as a backup.

Rafael
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.ai

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@veridianhealth.com>, Natalie Chen <natalie.chen@veridianhealth.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, May 22, 2027 at 4:30 PM PDT
Subject: Re: Redwood onsite demo — Friday 5/21 at 2:00pm PT

Hi Liam — thanks for the heads up and sorry again for the travel scramble. Plan we’ll execute Friday at 2:00pm PT (per original invite):

- Rafael will run the technical demo onsite and we will record the full session (Rafael / Logan).
- Marissa will upload the recording, add timestamps for the latency/cost and rollout sections, and share within 2 hours after the demo.
- I will run a brief 30-min executive follow-up with Natalie (and Liam if he’s available) the next business day to cover pricing and commitment milestones; proposed slots: Mon 5/24 at 2:00pm PT or 3:30pm PT.

If you prefer to postpone entirely to Monday 5/24, we can do that — Rafael confirmed availability 2:00–4:00pm. Otherwise we’ll proceed and make sure you have everything you need to sign off asynchronously.

Attached: redwood-demo-runbook.pdf (final run order).

Next steps for you: reply with preference (Proceed Friday and record / Postpone to Mon 5/24 2pm / Postpone to Mon 5/24 3:30pm).

Best,
Olga Petrov
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.ai
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments (record stub): [redwood-demo-runbook.pdf] (technical run + timestamps)
